Made by Advik, a ZeroOrigine adopted project. No accounts, no ads, no tracking: the game only counts how many times it was opened. Privacy

WASD or arrows to move, Space to jump, Shift to dash (you can't get hurt while dashing), F to fire the Dream Light, hold Space in the air to glide, 1, 4 to dance, C to switch camera (6 views!). Click the game to look around with your mouse (Esc gives the mouse back), or hold and drag. The camera also turns by itself to follow you when you run. On a phone: left stick moves, drag the right side to look. Touch a flag to save a checkpoint. Collect coins and gems to buy new characters.
